title: $800 Hampton Inns In New York: How City Hall Rewarded Rent-Seeking Contributors
summary: The cost of New York City hotel rooms was a political choice engineered to protect incumbents from competition, drive up rates, and make it possible to redistribute excess profits to hotel unions.

title: American Airlines And Citi Test A $695 Business Card That Could Earn 50% More Miles And Loyalty Points
summary: American Airlines and Citi are working on a $695 AAdvantage Executive card for small businesses. Here's some of what they're considering.

title: CardPointers Adds Amex And Chase Offers For You — Black Friday Cuts The Price To $50 A Year Or $150 For Life
summary: CardPointers+ can add the offer to an eligible card and tell you which one to bring. It’s 50% off through Cyber Monday, November 30 . A year costs $49.99 (usually $99.99), and lifetime access is $150 (usually $300).

title: Citi AAdvantage Business Card Review—75,000 Miles And Status Credit For Two People From The Same Spending
summary: The Citi / AAdvantage Business World Elite Mastercard can turn $125,000 in eligible spending on an employee card into American Airlines Platinum Pro status for two people. That’s without even earning any Loyalty Points from flying, a hotel booking or shopping through American’s portal.

title: Fake Amex Black Cards For $1,000—People Are Buying Status, But They May Be Committing A Crime
summary: A man apparently made a fortune selling fake American Express Black Cards for about $1,000 apiece. The cards used buyers' real account numbers, so when they paid for items the charges went onto their own bills. They were buying the appearance of being a Centurion cardmember.

title: Hilton’s Cyber Week Bonus Is Worth Just $8—But You Can Stack Three Offers For 10,000 Points On A Single Night
summary: Book a Hilton Sale rate and pay the whole bill with a U.S. Hilton American Express card and you can earn another 5,000 points once per cardholder (book by December 22, stay by April 2). Book by December 1 and check out by December 31 to combine all three offers. That’s 8,000 bonus points ($32) at most hotels. At a property on the higher bonus list, one night can earn 10,000 bonus points ($40) before you count the usual hotel and card earnings.

title: Hyatt Regency LAX Caps Stays At 21 Days—The Legal Risk That Makes Hotels Turn Away Paying Guests
summary: Hyatt Regency LAX won't let you stay more than 21 consecutive days. Booking separate reservations won't get around it. The hotel even counts back-to-back stays.

title: Hyatt Spotted A Bomb Threat Tweet—Deputies Identified The Suspect From Video Of Him Meowing [Roundup]
summary: A bomb threat tweeted in a furry convention thread had just five views when Hyatt security spotted it. Deputies say they identified a suspect by matching his tattoos to footage of him meowing at an officer. Plus, a free year of Grubhub+ and reports that former U.S. citizens are being forced to apply for visitor visas.

title: Southwest Gives You 55 Days Of Companion Pass For One Holiday Roundtrip (Even With Points) — Book By Sunday
summary: Southwest Airlines will give you a Companion Pass for a single holiday roundtrip, even if you book the cheapest Basic fare with points. From January 8 through March 3, 2027, you can bring someone on as many trips as you like for just the taxes and fees (from $5.60 each way). You can use points for your seat then, too.

title: Turkish Airlines Looks Up Rules For The Wrong Georgia — Passenger Loses A Week And $5,000
summary: Turkish Airlines seems to have looked up the wrong Georgia when a passenger checked in, and came up with the wrong rules for travel. A Georgian journalist and his partner were flying from Washington Dulles via Istanbul to visit family in the country next door to Turkey . He says the airline turned them away over a “Swine and Bird Import Permit” for their two pet parakeets. That's a permit you can get in Atlanta.
